name: token-budget
description: Set a token or dollar budget per session; get warned at 80% and stopped at 100%.

budgetUsd.title: Dollar budget per session
budgetUsd.description: Estimated spend (USD, API list prices) after which new prompts are paused. 0 turns the dollar limit off.

budgetTokens.title: Token budget per session
budgetTokens.description: Input, output and cache-write tokens after which new prompts are paused. 0 turns the token limit off.

warnAt.title: Warn at (%)
warnAt.description: Share of the budget at which a toast and a band above the prompt warn you.
